_note: Windows PowerShell form. Denies commit commands whose text mentions Claude/Anthropic.

hooks.command: $json = [Console]::In.ReadToEnd() | ConvertFrom-Json; $c = $json.tool_input.command; if ($c -match '(?i)claude|anthropic') { $r = @{hookSpecificOutput=@{hookEventName='PreToolUse';permissionDecision='deny';permissionDecisionReason='Commit blocked: message mentions Claude or Anthropic.'}}; $r | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 5 -Compress }
